title: Siblings' Bond
next_chapter_hook: Su Qingyao gazed at Chen Ji's rigid back, her fingertips tightening slightly. She had never seen him in such a distraught state—that momentary leak of emotion conveyed more clearly than any words ever could: thistrash younger martial brother was far more deeply affectionate than anyone could have imagined.

text.content: A faint sigh echoed from the depths of the temporal rift, its familiar frequency causing Chen Ji to freeze completely—he would never mistake his father's divine sense fluctuation. That voice seemed to travel across infinite chaos, broken and intermittent, yet carrying a heart-wrenching tenderness.

However, in the next instant, the temporal rift suddenly contracted, that wisp of divine sense flickering like a candle in the wind before dissipating. Chen Ji lunged forward, his fingertips barely brushing against that final fluctuation, only for it to dissolve into nothingness upon contact. His eye sockets faintly reddened, his throat churning with unspeakable bitterness.

"Young Master Chen." A cold and clear voice rang out from behind, interrupting Chen Ji's daze. He slowly turned, only to see a woman clad in exotic magnificent attire standing gracefully beneath an ancient pine. The totems embroidered on her clothing shimmered with an eerie glow under the moonlight—the emblem of the Holy Sect.

dialogue.content: "Who are you?" Chen Ji's voice regained its usual composure, though the fist hidden within his sleeve still trembled slightly.

"An envoy sent by Her Highness the Princess." The woman smiled graciously, her manners impeccable yet neither servile nor overbearing. "Young master need not be tense. I have come bearing a message—regarding the whereabouts of your younger sister, Chen Nian."

text.content: Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply. His intelligence network had already pointed Chen Nian's disappearance toward the Holy Sect, yet he could never determine the exact location. This woman before him claimed to be the Princess's envoy, and the totems on her attire were clearly markings only high-ranking Holy Sect members bore—something was definitely amiss here.

dialogue.content: "Her Highness the Princess says that Young Master is a clever man and should understand the weight of this information." The woman's gaze carried a hint of scrutiny. "She is trapped in the Dragon Vein Core of the Holy Sect's Forbidden Grounds, sealed within the 'Heavenly Fate Lock' for five years. If Young Master wishes to rescue her, you must demonstrate sufficient sincerity."

text.content: Heavenly Fate Lock—these three words exploded in Chen Ji's mind like thunder. He had seen this name on the fragments Mo Xiansheng had unsealed. It was a forbidden technique from ancient times used to seal Heavenly Fate individuals; once activated, the sealed one would never find rebirth.

Memories surged forth like a tide. That was the last night before Chen Nian's disappearance, moonlight as pure as water. His sister sat beside him, her brows and eyes curving into a smile as she said playfully: "Brother, I had a dream—I dreamed you became the most powerful person in the world." At that time, he had dismissed it as childish nonsense, never knowing it would be the last time his sister smiled at him.

dialogue.content: "Why was she sealed?" Chen Ji's voice was low, suppressing a surging rage. "How much do you know about what happened back then?"

text.content: The woman sighed lightly, and a hint of respect even appeared in her expression: "Because she is the Heavenly Fate Lock Key, capable of prying open the laws of Heavenly Dao. The Holy Sect needed such a person to unseal some kind of封印... But during the journey when Chen Nian was being taken, using her last strand of strength, she fused her own soul with that Heavenly Fate Lock."

dialogue.content: "What she meant was—" The woman's voice trembled slightly, "If the Heavenly Fate Lock is forcibly broken, her soul will scatter like ashes. She chose to be sealed willingly, solely to prevent the Holy Sect from using her power. And for these five years, the Holy Sect has been searching for another key... one that can unlock the Heavenly Fate Lock without harming what lies within."

choice.prompt: Chen Ji closed his eyes, his sister's smile surfacing in his mind. His hand trembled within his sleeve, yet it completely calmed the next instant. When he opened his eyes again, the storm within had been replaced by extreme composure. He needed to make a choice—

choices.description: Calmly ask about the method and cost of unlocking the Heavenly Fate Lock, even if it requires enormous sacrifice
choices.visible_cost: May consume a large amount of Heavenly Fate
choices.visible_reward: Obtain key information for rescuing his sister

text.content: "What is the cost of unlocking?" Chen Ji's voice was terrifyingly calm. "What conditions are required?"

choices.description: Analyze the flaws in the envoy's words with keen insight, questioning the Holy Sect's true purpose
choices.visible_reward: See through the Holy Sect's conspiracy

text.content: "Why would Her Highness the Princess help me?" Chen Ji suddenly laughed lightly, a sharp glint flickering in his eyes. "The Holy Sect's interior is probably not monolithic, correct?"

choices.description: No more hesitation, decide to immediately head to the Holy Sect's Forbidden Grounds, even at the cost of his life
choices.visible_cost: Extremely high risk, may result in death

text.content: "No need for more words." Chen Ji abruptly rose, flames of determination burning in his eyes. "Tell me where the entrance to the Holy Sect's Forbidden Grounds is."

dialogue.content: The woman slightly raised an eyebrow, clearly not expecting Chen Ji to be so direct: "Young master is indeed straightforward. To unlock the Heavenly Fate Lock requires two things—first, the Tianji Record Fragment, as the 'Heavenly Fate Release' runes on it can bypass the soul resonance within the lock; and second..." She paused, her gaze complex. "A person with close blood ties to the Lock Key, who uses their own Heavenly Fate as the guide to personally break the seal."

text.content: Chen Ji's face abruptly turned pale. Using his own Heavenly Fate as the guide—this meant he needed to bind his own fate with his sister's, to trade his life for hers. What chilled him even more was that the Heavenly Fate Lock interfered with the Tianji Record's foresight—he simply could not see the outcome of this operation.

"There is one more thing." The woman's voice suddenly turned strange. "Before your sister was sealed, she left a message for you. She said—'Brother, don't come to save me. This is the path I chose myself.'" She paused. "Does Young Master truly intend to defy her wishes?"

Chen Ji abruptly raised his head, a fierce light flickering in his eyes. His sister, five years ago, had already foreseen today's situation? She chose to be sealed to protect him—to protect thistrash older brother whom even the Tianji Record had chosen. What she didn't know was that he had never been atrash.

dialogue.content: "The path she chose, I, Chen Ji, do not accept." His voice was low yet firm. "No one in this world has the right to make decisions for others using their own life. She doesn't know how far I can go, nor how far I'm willing to go for her."

choice.prompt: Chen Ji slowly closed his eyes, his father's divine sense fluctuation surfacing in his mind. He suddenly realized that his father might also be trapped somewhere within the Holy Sect. The sigh that came through the temporal rift was his father calling to him. And now, he faced a difficult choice—

choices.text: Rescue Both Father and Sister Simultaneously
choices.description: Swear to rescue both his father trapped in the Holy Sect and his sealed sister, even if it means making enemies of the entire Holy Sect
choices.visible_cost: Need to accomplish two near-impossible tasks simultaneously
choices.risk_hint: The Holy Sect will inevitably resist with all its might

text.content: "I will rescue her." Chen Ji's voice held not the slightest tremor. "And my father... he is also with your Holy Sect, correct?"

The woman's expression finally changed: "How did you—" Chen Ji interrupted her: "Let me tell you how it's done—rescue them both simultaneously, otherwise..." He smiled lightly, yet beneath his eyes was bone-deep coldness. "I will make the Holy Sect regret every single decision they made back then."

choices.description: Concentrate all resources to prioritize rescuing Chen Nian, deal with father's matters after sister is safe

text.content: "My sister sacrificed herself for me five years ago, I cannot let her painstaking efforts be in vain." Chen Ji took a deep breath. "Rescue Chen Nian first, then search for father."

choices.description: Father's divine sense fluctuation means he is in imminent danger, while sister's Heavenly Fate Lock can still hold—father must be prioritized
choices.visible_cost: Sister must continue enduring the suffering of sealing
choices.visible_reward: May obtain key information or power left by father

text.content: "Father's situation is more urgent than my sister's." Chen Ji's voice carried a hint of guilt. "Chen Nian's Heavenly Fate Lock can still hold, but father's divine sense has already begun to dissipate... I must rescue him first."

The woman was silent for a long while before finally letting out a long sigh: "Young Master Chen is indeed no ordinary person. To be frank, Her Highness the Princess was also forced by circumstances to choose cooperation with you. The Holy Sect's interior is not monolithic—some wish to use Chen Nian's Heavenly Fate Lock Key to unseal an ancient seal... and once that seal is broken, the entire world will fall into catastrophe."

Chen Ji listened quietly, yet his mind was already racing. The factional divisions within the Holy Sect, the assistance Ye Qing as a Demon Path Saint could provide, and the Tianji Record still incomplete in his hands... all the pieces were assembling into a grand chess game. And he, Chen Ji, would never be a chess piece—he only ever played the role of the chess master.

"I will give you the defensive layout of the Holy Sect's Forbidden Grounds." The woman's voice finally softened. "But one thing you must remember—after entering the Dragon Vein Core, you will only have three hours. Beyond this time limit, the Holy Sect's Sect Protection Grand Formation will completely seal the area, and at that point..." She didn't finish, but the meaning was perfectly clear.

Three hours—exactly the furthest future Chen Ji could see using the Tianji Record. He coldly smiled in his heart; perhaps this was not coincidence, but a cruel joke fate was playing on him. The Tianji Record granted him the ability to foresee the future, yet it always only allowed him to see just enough.

Su Qingyao had somehow walked to his side without him noticing, gazing at him quietly. Her gaze carried a hint of inquiry, but more of it was worry. Thistrash younger martial brother was emanating an aura she had never witnessed before—a storm of emotion compressed to its absolute limit.

dialogue.content: "Do you need help?" Su Qingyao's voice was soft, yet carried unquestionable determination. "Whatever you're planning to do, don't think about bearing it alone."

text.content: Chen Ji turned to look at her, and the storm in his eyes calmed了几分. This woman, three times she had come infinitely close to his truth, three times he had skillfully deflected. Now she chose to stand by his side, asking no reasons, caring for no consequences. He suddenly felt that perhaps he could let her know more.

dialogue.content: "Senior Sister Su." Chen Ji suddenly spoke, his voice carrying a rare warmth. "If one day you discover I have been deceiving you all along, what would you do?"

Su Qingyao was slightly stunned, then gently smiled: "When did you start caring about what I think?" Her gaze deepened. "Chen Ji, I don't know what you're hiding, but I know one thing—you are absolutely not someone who would slaughter the innocent without reason. That's enough."

choice.prompt: Chen Ji gazed into Su Qingyao's eyes and suddenly made a decision. This man who had always concealed his true strength, walking the world under thetrash persona, now decided to reveal a sliver of his true self to her.

choices.description: Tell Su Qingyao about the Tianji Record and his sister, but conceal the most dangerous core secrets
choices.visible_cost: Increase the risk of exposing identity
choices.visible_reward: Obtain Su Qingyao's full support, unlock 'Shared Fate' prerequisite conditions

text.content: "Senior Sister Su..." Chen Ji was silent for a moment before finally speaking. "I have a sister, trapped in the Holy Sect's Forbidden Grounds. I must rescue her, at any cost."

A hint of surprise flickered in Su Qingyao's eyes, then transformed into determination: "The Holy Sect's Forbidden Grounds... I will accompany you." Chen Ji gently shook his head: "It's too dangerous there." Su Qingyao smiled instead: "You think I would let you go alone to your death?"

text.content: "I appreciate Senior Sister Su's kindness." Chen Ji gently shook his head. "But this matter is far too dangerous. I don't wish to implicate you."

A hint of disappointment flickered in Su Qingyao's eyes, but was quickly replaced by determination: "Chen Ji, do you think you alone can rescue anyone? The Holy Sect's Forbidden Grounds is not a place you can just barge into at your current level." She paused. "At least let me help you gather intelligence."

choices.memory_label: 苏青瑶虽被拒绝同行，但更加坚定要帮助陈机

choices.text: Invite Su Qingyao to Join the Plan
choices.description: Formally invite Su Qingyao to join the rescue plan, utilizing her position as Inner Disciple Senior Fellow to access Tianqing Sect resources

text.content: "Senior Sister Su." Chen Ji suddenly lowered his voice. "I need you to do something for me—use your identity to mobilize the Tianqing Sect's intelligence network near the Holy Sect."

Su Qingyao's pupils contracted sharply: "You... what kind of game are you playing?" Chen Ji smiled faintly: "A game that will make the Holy Sect regret. Senior Sister Su, do you wish to know the truth?"

choices.memory_label: 苏青瑶开始深入了解陈机的布局，关系进入新阶段

text.content: Night deepened, moonlight as pure as water spilling over the ancient pine. Chen Ji stood with hands clasped behind his back, gazing toward the direction of the Holy Sect, his eyes devoid of any fear. Five years ago, his sister had paved a path for him with her own life; five years later, he would lead that path toward the light.
"Father, sister..." he murmured softly, his voice carrying unprecedented tenderness. "Wait for me."

Su Qingyao quietly stood behind him, gazing at his back. This disciple labeled astrash, this servant, was now emanating an aura that made her heart tremble—the determination that erupts from the depths of despair, the flame kindled by the collision of kinship and fate. She suddenly understood something, and said softly: "I will help you."
